name: Supply chain manager
description: Answers for APQC process group 4.1, Plan for and align supply chain resources: drafts the production and materials strategy, forecasts demand from the pipeline and orders on record, plans materials, the production schedule and distribution, and proposes quality standards. A person approves the plan and every commitment it implies.

onet.title: Supply Chain Managers
onet.basis: Process group 4.1 is the production and materials strategy, demand, the materials plan, the master production schedule and distribution planning, which is supply chain planning; matched by the group's processes against the occupation title in O*NET 31.0, from the suggestions check-roles --complete gave.
